description: This file defines classes for API key-based authentication in a FastAPI application, supporting authentication via query parameters, headers, and cookies. It includes mechanisms for error handling and dependency injection.

classes.name: APIKeyBase
classes.description: Base class for API key authentication, providing common error handling and API key validation.

classes.name: APIKeyQuery
classes.description: Handles API key authentication via URL query parameters.

classes.name: APIKeyHeader
classes.description: Handles API key authentication via HTTP headers.

classes.name: APIKeyCookie
classes.description: Handles API key authentication via cookies.

methods.name: make_not_authenticated_error
methods.description: Creates an HTTP 401 Unauthorized exception with WWW-Authenticate header.

methods.name: check_api_key
methods.description: Validates the provided API key, raising an error if invalid and auto_error is True.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Extracts API key from request (query, header, or cookie) and validates it.
